title: Otori Emu — The Same Face As Mr. Octopus☆〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: The Same Face As Mr. Octopus☆（4★）
meta.Event: Paint What I Love♪ Rainbow Canvas

rows.Line: Emu's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, now that you two have learned to draw a good number of animals, let's call it a day.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We drew so many too!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, we did...!
But drawing's still very challenging to me...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I think you've improved a lot compared to when we first started. The cat you drew towards the end was really cute.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I-It was? Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Thank you for teaching us today, Ena!
It was super duper fun!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I had fun too.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Oh, did you all just finish?
I brought some tea and snacks.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay! Thanks, Sis!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you very much. We really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
No, this is no big deal.
Please relax and enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thank you. We'll do just that.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
She said this is no big deal...
But these teacups... Aren't they a famous brand?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really? These are supposed to be her favorites. Are they that famous?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I went to a nice place the other day for afternoon tea and pretty sure the cups were made by the same brand.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Still, these look way more intricate...
I've gotta think they're worth a pretty penny...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We're just having tea, but I'm starting to feel a little nervous. I need to be careful to not let it slip out of my hand...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
From that painting to these teacups...
Emu, your house is full of all these artistic treasures.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Most of the stuff decorated around the house is stuff my grandpa bought or received from friends as gifts♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: He got the painting in the living room from a friend who lives in Europe!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: As a gift?! I understand buying a painting like that, but receiving one from a friend?! How?! Why?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Haha... Emu's grandfather founded Phoenix Wonderland, so he must've been an incredible human being.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah... It's not every day that you get to see such a famous painting up close. It was a real treat for my eyes.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Then, would you like to see more?
The living room isn't the only place where we have stuff on display♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes! Also, um...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Can you tell me more about who drew which painting and any stories associated with them?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Didn't your grandfather tell you about them?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I heard some stories from him, but he didn't know about all of them. And the person who gave them to him usually did most of the talking...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I see.
Then, I'll give explanations where I can.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay☆ Thank you so much, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's wonderful, Emu.
I think I'll take this opportunity to also learn more about art.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, we can learn together♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, let's head down to the living room!
Otori Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ta-daa!
This is the living room!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I still can't believe how many famous paintings are on display here. This place really does seem like an art museum...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Also, Emu, something's been bugging me ever since you led us up to your room...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's Avatino Monapoc's “Acorus Calamus”, right? Is it the original...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Um... I think so... We have to take it down whenever we loan it out to museums♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Y-You've gotta be kidding me...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm speechless as well...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, these paintings are lovely, but so is this end table. It's so beautifully designed...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That was made over 100 years ago in England! At least, that's what one of my big brothers said.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's a real antique...?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
H-Hang on...!
This design... I forget their name, but only one person in the world can make such ornate decorations...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What?! Is it that rare?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow, I didn't know that!
Thanks, Ena! I'm really glad you're here to look at all these things!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I'm nothing special, really!
I just happened to recognize it is all.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Still, what was that person's name...
I'll try looking them up when I get home.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Woohoo! Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Next, we'll head to the room where we chat with our guests!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Emu's Room

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That concludes our little expedition and tour of my house! What did you both think?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It was just one surprise after another. My brain's still having trouble processing everything. Your house has more works of art than some lesser-known art museums...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She's right. Things that I'd only ever seen in textbooks are on display in your hallway...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. I thought my heart was gonna stop when I saw Kavrough's “Morning Glories”...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. That's been one of my favorites forever. I really wanted to hang it up in my room...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I was told that it's really hard to maintain and how it's not good to expose it to sunlight.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, I asked to have it hung up somewhere close to my room which makes it look like the flowers are in full bloom! And Grandpa found that spot!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I see.
Hehe. Your grandfather must've been a wonderful person.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ever since I had to say goodbye to Grandpa, I've been greeting those morning glories every day.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm hoping that, through them, he'll be able to hear me!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Right. Those morning glories mean a lot to you because they meant a lot to him.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you for showing it to us, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I think we both learned a lot.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, it was my pleasure! I got to learn so much about all the works of art that Grandpa left to us, so I'm really happy!
